summary: HTTP SSE replaces a terminal quota failure with a later transport error, making the refused sampling request retryable.
scenario: A response.failed event with insufficient_quota is decoded, then the byte stream reports a network read error while closing; the consumer receives ApiError::Stream instead of ApiError::QuotaExceeded, and core may submit another sampling request.

evidence.point: process_sse_with_treatment stores the terminal failure but a later stream read error takes precedence
WebSocket path returns the classified terminal error immediately
ApiError::Stream maps to CodexErr::Stream while QuotaExceeded maps to a terminal error
CodexErr::Stream has retry delay; CodexErr::QuotaExceeded does not
sampling loop passes stream errors to retry handling and repeats after Ok(())

trace: ResponsesClient::stream_request -> spawn_response_stream -> process_sse_with_treatment -> process_responses_event(QuotaExceeded) -> later byte-stream error overwrites it -> map_api_error(Stream) -> run_sampling_request/handle_response_stream_error -> retry

authority.source: OpenAI Responses streaming event reference and official Agents SDK terminal-state guidance
authority.quote: An event that is emitted when a response fails.

proof.name: failed_response_keeps_terminal_classification_when_transport_fails_afterward
proof.command: RUSTC_WRAPPER= HOST_CC=clang HOST_CXX=clang++ CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/codex-harness-audit/retry/codex-rs/target just test -p codex-api -E 'test(failed_response_keeps_terminal_classification_when_transport_fails_afterward)'
proof.output: Summary: 1 test run, 0 passed, 1 failed; observed Some(Err(Stream("Transport error: network error: transport failed after terminal response"))) rather than Some(Err(ApiError::QuotaExceeded)).

severity: High for affected HTTP SSE turns: a terminal quota refusal is misreported as a transient disconnection and may be retried up to the configured stream budget, adding delay and unnecessary requests. Requires a transport read failure or idle timeout after the terminal event; WebSocket path is unaffected.
